scope: Primary image loader and STB sources; unchanged pinned support implementations verified by hash. Other engine behavior is not certified by this codec adapter.

header_only.reason: The primary stb BMP parser computes a negative palette size for this minimal OS/2 bitmap, then reads uninitialized palette entries. Pixel values are not a valid reference; header dimensions remain defined. The padded variant exercises the same source pixels with initialized entries.

This bitmap stores four palette entries but references index 31. The primary stb loader reads an uninitialized palette entry; only header dimensions are a valid native reference. Rust rejects the out-of-range index. The full-table variant provides a defined native pixel control.
